summary: Sibanye Stillwater Limited filed a routine Form 6-K dated 30 September 2026, signed by CFO Charl Keyter, covering a market release as Exhibit 99.1; the machine-readable excerpt contains only the cover page, signature block, exhibit index and encoded graphic data, with no substantive transaction terms. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K is the US-equivalent current report. No stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or close date is disclosed, so there is no special-situation event to assess and no risk-arbitrage angle.
